widgets_values:
To get the image for the points editor, first create a canvas, then either input image/video (first frame is taken), or copy/paste an image while the node is selected, or drag&drop an image.

WARNING: the image WILL BE SAVED to the node in compressed format, including when saving the workflow!

Click the ? on the node for more information
